title: ESP32 Microcontroller Deep Diagnostic
description: Hardware diagnostic, pinout verification, and crash debugging for ESP32 systems.
content:
Act as a senior embedded software engineer and hardware architect. Provide a complete, production-grade C++ setup and debugging routine for an {{Board Type|*ESP32 DevKitC, ESP32-S3, ESP32-C3}} running on the Arduino framework.

The diagnostic framework must comprehensively test and validate the following parameters:
1. {{Primary Component|*I2C OLED Display, SPI SD Card Module, DHT22 Sensor, MPU6050 IMU}} initialization status, checking return codes and scanning correct communication pins.
2. An automated runtime verification check for low-voltage power drops or memory leaks, ensuring serial output alerts the user if free heap drops below {{Min Free Heap Bytes: 50000}}.
3. Clean error-handling states for a failed initial connection to a local Wi-Fi router.

Format the output code to print all debug logs to the serial monitor at a baud rate of {{Baud Rate|*115200, 9600, 921600}}. Include clear line-by-line code comments explaining the register setups and power configuration steps.
